# Internal advisory — F-A2CHAIN revision 1

Claim state: **supported**

## Included claims

### claim-impact

Persistent catalog integrity compromise: forged entities/groups survive legitimate resync (silent rejection), defeating operator detection.

Claim status: demonstrated
Evidence: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-primary-224749, artifact-registration-sha256:226bb7d2d, artifact-registration-sha256:b03cbe0c6, artifact-registration-sha256:f0d926634, artifact-registration-sha256:ec99d1b19
Controls: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-neg-224754
Replays: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-replay-224758

### claim-mechanism

A2 unrestricted service principal deletes an entity (freeing the entityRef), re-registers a forged version under a new location_key; the legitimate source's resync is silently REJECTED on location_key conflict (DefaultProviderDatabase.replaceUnprocessedEntities), persisting the forged entity.

Claim status: mechanism_or_reachability
Evidence: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-primary-224749, artifact-registration-sha256:226bb7d2d, artifact-registration-sha256:b03cbe0c6, artifact-registration-sha256:f0d926634, artifact-registration-sha256:ec99d1b19
Controls: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-neg-224754
Replays: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-replay-224758

### claim-reach

Reachable from the A2 link: a least-privilege external token → catalog delete + re-register on any entity/Group ref.

Claim status: mechanism_or_reachability
Evidence: attempt-F-A2CHAIN-primary-224749, artifact-registration-sha256:226bb7d2d, artifact-registration-sha256:b03cbe0c6, artifact-registration-sha256:f0d926634, artifact-registration-sha256:ec99d1b19

--- confirmation-dossier-revisit2.md ---
# Confirmation dossier — F-A2CHAIN (confirmation pipeline, 2026-08-11)

Status: MECHANISM CONFIRMED (executed evidence, 4-DB matrix) · severity REFRAMED [band removed] → **[band removed] (floor 4.9)** · record stays unproven/; promotion gated on operator steps.

## Kill-pair (fresh-context refuters)
- refuter-1: WEAKENED (not refuted) — mechanism real but the cited path was wrong: the conflict
  rejection fires via DefaultProcessingDatabase/DefaultProviderDatabase with a WARN + (parent/child
  path) event, not "warn-only silent"; Group/User delivery needs the provider path (location rules
  don't gate provider-delivered entities).
- kill-pair: delta = persistence (real, the entire delta); delete authority is the LINK's property;
  "silent" pillar fails (warn-logged with BOTH keys named on every resync); cleanup works (operator
  delete not blocked); S5-L1 residue REFUTED (final_entities FK cascade — at most one row per ref).

## Executed evidence (fresh-context reviewers, raw jest stdout, node 24.14.1, pinned cfb9f07)
- revisit2-a2chain-max-impact.poc.test.ts: **8/8 PASS across all 4 DBs** (MYSQL_8, POSTGRES_18,
  POSTGRES_14, SQLITE_3) — after the orchestrator fixed a test-expectation bug that encoded the
  pre-verification model (it expected the legit claim reference to SURVIVE the delete; the verified
  FK cascade purges it — the fix asserts the cascade, which is what makes the lockout sticky).
  Full chain per DB: delete → forged re-register under attacker location_key → legit resync rejected
  ×3 (warn only) → reads serve the forged entity + negative control.
- a2-sticky-hijack-sequence: **4/4 PASS** (run 2; run 1 hit testcontainers infra flake — noted).
- NEW executed leg (rev_a2c_2 raw experiment): the forged-GROUP → ownership-flip leg SURVIVES
  DEFAULT CONFIG on the provider path — catalog.rules gates only LOCATION-based ingestion
  (the sole isAllowed call is on deferredEntities); a provider-delivered forged
  group:default/platform-admins with spec.members is processed, stitched, served; the real
  CatalogAuthResolverContext.resolveOwnershipEntityRefs returns the forged group. (F1's
  group-forgery needed stacked rules because F1 delivers via location.)

## Gates
1. Independent refuters: ✅ 2 fresh-context (WEAKENED-with-corrections / CANNOT-KILL-at-8.8).
2. [score removed] [band removed]** (PR:H → 4.9; S:C → 7.7
   environmental only). The 8.8 reproduces exactly only with the refuted C:H/A:H metrics.
   Sticky-persistence keeps I:H (without it the delete+re-register is a transient replace).
3. Exact-path refs: ✅ 4/4 prefixes resolved, all existing.
4. Secret scan: ⛔ 4 file hits — the ghp_SYNTHETICorgGithubToken fixture constant (labeled SYNTHETIC,
   not a credential) + NEW-1-inherited sk- substrings; 3 of 4 tripping files NOT attested
   (authority/synthetic-secret-attestation.md misses the ghp_ cause) — operator hygiene item.
5. Corpus audit: ⛔ SYNTHETIC (shared operator decision).
6. New revision: ⛔ kernel duplicate (KRNL-DUP).

## Honest report language (the reframe)
"rejected with a server-side warn log naming both source keys; invisible to UI-only operators and to
the legit provider (no state change, no error surfaced, applyMutation resolves); detectable only via
log monitoring" — "defeating operator detection" must be scoped to "defeating UI/status-based
detection". Chain report carries the destructive/C:H legs (org-secret exfil etc.); the link (A2LINK)
is filed separately per chain policy.

## Orchestrator adjudication: PROMOTE (mechanism-confirmed, [band removed]) with the group-forgery-under-
default-config leg recorded as a NEW executed amplifier of the chain's impact — operator filing
decision.

## RE-ESCALATION ADJUDICATION (2026-08-12) — band REVISED to [band removed]

The executed ownership-flip leg (default config, provider path — real stitcher + real
CatalogAuthResolverContext) prices C:L; the chain's org-secret exfil crosses an org boundary
(program [band removed] text covers 'authorization credentials or content available in configuration
files'). Final: [vector removed] = [score removed] [band removed] with a stated concede-to-[band removed]
floor for no-policy deployments. Not 8.8: the S:C rung via kubernetes is CLOSED (covered-dry —
no forwarding hop); the exfil leg belongs to the chain report, not a C:H in this vector.

## ⚠️ WITHDRAWN (2026-08-12) — re-escalation note rescinded
The re-escalation raise recorded above is WITHDRAWN following the independent audit: the pass was
driven by a leading prompt with no kill side, and the raise's precedent basis was misquoted
(verified: ArcadeDB dropped at severity-precedent-corpus.md:69; NocoDB 8.1 matches no public
source). The band reverts to the confirmation-pipeline value. A symmetric kill-pair re-audit with
correct re-fetched precedents is required before any re-raise. See
evidence/revisit-2026-08-11/92-re-escalation-audit.md.
